# `sim/particles/RopeParticleInteraction.js`

> **Source:** `engine/sim/particles/RopeParticleInteraction.js`

RopeParticleInteraction.js — CPU-side per-tick bridge between free particles and ropes. Runs each simulation frame and performs: 1. Spatial proximity query: find free particles near each rope node 2. Heat transfer: fire/lava/plasma → rope heats up; ice/snow → rope cools 3. Moisture absorption: water/blood/honey near rope → rope gets heavier, sags 4. Corrosion: acid particles eat away rope integrity 5. Thermal conduction: heat spreads along the rope between adjacent nodes 6. Burning: when node temperature exceeds burn threshold → ignite, char, break 7. Chain splitting: when integrity reaches 0 → break constraint → 2 separate chains Works with ALL materials including steel/chain — metal softens and eventually breaks at high enough temperatures (lava, plasma). Thresholds differ per material. This is a CPU-side system because it needs to: - Make topology decisions (break constraints, split chains) - Spawn new emitters (fire/smoke on burning rope) - Modify per-constraint mass values (moisture → heavier)

## Functions

### `createRopeInteractionSystem()`

Create the rope↔particle interaction system. Attach to the particle world and call stepRopeInteraction() each tick.

**Returns:** Interaction system state

### `registerRopeForInteraction(system, entityId, ropeMetadata, fiberMaterial, ambientTemp = 293)`

Register a rope for interaction tracking. Call this after createGPURope.

**Parameters:**

- `system` *(Object)* — Interaction system
- `entityId` *(number)* — Rope entity ID
- `ropeMetadata` *(Object)* — From createGPURope (particleStart, particleCount, etc.)
- `fiberMaterial` *(string)* — Material name (hemp, steel, chain, silk, etc.)
- `[ambientTemp` *(number)* — =293] - Starting temperature

### `unregisterRopeInteraction(system, entityId)`

Unregister a rope (cleanup).

**Parameters:**

- `system` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityId` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `stepRopeInteraction(system, world, positionsCPU, thermalCPU, metaCPU, dt, callbacks = {})`

Step the rope↔particle interaction system.

**Parameters:**

- `system` *(Object)* — Interaction system from createRopeInteractionSystem()
- `world` *(Object)* — Particle sim world (has ropeChains, position readback, etc.)
- `positionsCPU` *(Float32Array)* — CPU-side particle positions (vec4 per particle)
- `thermalCPU` *(Float32Array)* — CPU-side thermal data (vec4 per particle: temp, phase, packedGroupMat, latent)
- `metaCPU` *(Float32Array|null)* — CPU-side meta buffer (vec4 per particle: r,g,b,packed)
- `dt` *(number)* — Time step in seconds
- `[callbacks]` *(Object)* — Optional callbacks for spawning effects
- `[callbacks.onNodeIgnited]` *(Function)* — (entityId, nodeIndex, position)
- `[callbacks.onNodeBroken]` *(Function)* — (entityId, nodeIndex, position)
- `[callbacks.onRopeSplit]` *(Function)* — (entityId, nodeIndex, childA, childB)
- `[callbacks.onMassChanged]` *(Function)* — (entityId, nodeIndex, newMass)

### `getRopeInteractionState(system, entityId)`

Get the current interaction state for a rope.

**Parameters:**

- `system` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityId` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** { temperature[], moisture[], integrity[], burning[], isBurning, burningNodes }

## Notes & Examples

### Physics Engine Integration

The physics system provides rigid body dynamics, collision detection, and raycasting. Bodies have shapes (box, sphere, mesh), mass properties, and constraints. The GPU physics engine accelerates broad-phase collision detection and particle systems.

**Example: Creating physics bodies**
```js
import { PhysicsWorld } from 'engine/physics/PhysicsWorld.js';
import { RigidBody } from 'engine/physics/RigidBody.js';
import { BoxShape, SphereShape } from 'engine/physics/Shapes.js';

const world = new PhysicsWorld({ gravity: [0, -9.8, 0] });

// Static ground
const ground = new RigidBody({
  type: 'static',
  shape: new BoxShape(10, 1, 10),
  position: [0, -0.5, 0]
});
world.addBody(ground);

// Dynamic box
const box = new RigidBody({
  type: 'dynamic',
  mass: 1,
  shape: new BoxShape(1, 1, 1),
  position: [0, 5, 0],
  restitution: 0.5  // Bounciness
});
world.addBody(box);
```

**Advanced: Collision detection and raycasting**
```js
// Raycast to find what the player is looking at
const hit = world.raycast(camera.position, camera.forward, 100);
if (hit) {
  console.log('Hit entity:', hit.body.entityId);
  console.log('Hit point:', hit.point);
  console.log('Hit normal:', hit.normal);
  
  // Apply impulse at hit point
  hit.body.applyImpulse([0, 10, 0], hit.point);
}

// Shapecast (swept sphere) for character movement
const sweep = world.shapecast(
  player.position,           // Start
  desiredPosition,           // End
  new SphereShape(0.5),    // Player capsule radius
  { ignore: player.body }  // Don't collide with self
);
if (sweep.hit) {
  // Slide along wall
  player.position = sweep.position;
}
```

**Advanced: Constraints and joints**
```js
import { HingeConstraint, FixedConstraint } from 'engine/physics/Constraints.js';

// Door hinge
const doorHinge = new HingeConstraint({
  bodyA: doorFrame,
  bodyB: door,
  pivot: [0, 1, 0],      // Hinge location
  axis: [0, 1, 0],       // Hinge axis (Y up)
  limits: [-90, 90]      // Open angle range in degrees
});
world.addConstraint(doorHinge);

// Ragdoll joint (ball-and-socket)
const shoulder = new FixedConstraint({
  bodyA: torso,
  bodyB: arm,
  pivotA: [0.5, 1.5, 0],  // Shoulder position on torso
  pivotB: [0, 0, 0]       // Shoulder position on arm
});
world.addConstraint(shoulder);
```

**Advanced: Continuous collision detection (CCD)**
```js
// Fast-moving objects need CCD to not tunnel through walls
const projectile = new RigidBody({
  type: 'dynamic',
  shape: new SphereShape(0.1),
  mass: 0.1,
  ccd: { enabled: true, sweptSphereRadius: 0.1 },
  linearDamping: 0  // No air resistance for bullets
});
projectile.velocity = [0, 0, 100];  // Very fast
world.addBody(projectile);
```

**Gotchas:**
- **Units**: Physics uses meters, kilograms, seconds. A 1-unit cube is 1 meter.
- **Time step**: Fixed time step (1/60) gives stable simulation; variable dt causes explosions.
- **Collision layers**: Use collision masks to filter what collides (player vs enemy, bullet vs world).
- **Sleeping**: At-rest bodies sleep to save CPU — wake them before applying forces.
